title: A filter on a one-side column filters the many-side table

source.quote: In a one-to-many relationship, the direction is always from the one-side of the relationship to the many-side
source.supports: a single-direction one-to-many relationship propagates the filter from the one side (Customer) to the many side (Sales)

source.quote: For one-to-many relationships, the cross filter direction is always from the "one" side, and optionally from the "many" side (bi-directional)
source.supports: filters always propagate from the one side

derivation: US customers are Ann (1) and Bob (2). Sales rows with CustomerKey 1: rows 1, 2, 7 = 100 + 40 + 100 = 240. CustomerKey 2: rows 3, 4 = 20 + 50 = 70. 240 + 70 = 310. SUM of a fixed decimal column is a fixed decimal.
